_note: What the customer says over the dialogue strip, in both halves of the game. build.mjs INLINES this as const DIALOGUE - never fetched at runtime (CSP, file:// CORS). Edit here, then run: node build.mjs
_rules: ALL CAPS, 5x7 font characters only, at most 34 characters per line (the kitchen's strip is the narrow one), and never wider than the speech bubble beside the widest baked face. build.mjs rejects anything else and says how much to trim.
_era: A line may start with an era floor: '2|' means the 1980s and 1990s only, '3|' the 1990s only. Use it for anything that did not exist yet in 1972 (the Filofax, the pager, McFly). No prefix = any era. build.mjs strips the prefix before checking width, and rejects any other use of '|'. who, delivered and missed carry no prefixes: the shipped G.react reads them raw.
_voice: Mostly from Migrated/angry-customer-lines-vol1.md and vol2.md: the Midwest regulars, the trucker, the lunch-break dad, the bridge-club grandma. Nothing crude, nothing ableist, no put-on accents, nothing from after the year on screen (no internet, no chains that were not there). The game is public.
_keys: delivered / missed / late are the Delivery Shift (late = it arrived, but the tip had run down). arrive / wait / queue / walkout / served / wrong are the Kitchen Shift: a new ticket, patience under 30%, the line is past 3, patience ran out, a ticket served, a wrong pick.
